about: A toy, not a measurement: m(theta) = 1 + s0 t + q t^2 + c t^3 (t = theta - theta0) plus independent Gaussian noise sigma at every evaluation, differentiated at theta0 by a two-point central difference at +-h, the five-point stencil at +-h, +-2h (weights (-1, 8, -8, 1)/12; h = 0.02 theta0, the study's H_MAIN) and DerivKit (cosmolike_notebook_utils.fisher.get_ddv_dkit, min_samples 7, fallback_mode poly_at_floor: theta0 and +-1, 1.5, 2.25, 3.375, 5% of theta0, a weighted straight line), as in tests/studies/run_fisher_derivatives.py. example: one typical realization (the first of its own seeded stream in which every estimator lands within one of its own analytic standard deviations of the true slope; example_attempt counts the draws), every evaluation (theta, m) and each slope. distribution: (estimate - s0)/s0 over n_real realizations (mean, sd, percentiles), the analytic sd from the estimator's weights, the bias of the noise-free toy (the cubic term), and deterministic_error, the error on the noise-free deterministic ripple A sin(2 pi t/L) alone (the same in every realization). Written by make_derivkit_schematic_data.py in this folder.
